bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-gallery-flow-034fa01"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "034fa012cf96e0288591fbe4bc16b90cee1acfa0" || exit 52
newtag="create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01"
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newtag")"
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' create-videobot:before-gallery-034fa01)"
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 54
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$ids")" = "$oldid" || { echo CURRENT_CREATOR_RUNTIME_CHANGED; exit 55; }
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$ids")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$ids")"
base="$(printf '%s' "$files" | cut -d, -f1)"
case "$base" in *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 56;; esac
test -f "$base" || exit 57
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" config --quiet || exit 58
overrides="$root/.worktrees/gallery-flow-deploy-034fa01"
mkdir -p "$overrides"
cat > "$overrides/live.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:gallery-flow-034fa01
YAML
cat > "$overrides/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:before-gallery-034fa01
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" config --quiet || exit 59
changed=0
rollback() {
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 set +e
 if test "$changed" = 1; then
  docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null
  echo CREATOR_VIDEO_FLOW_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED
 fi
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
changed=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$base" -f "$overrides/live.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 8
after="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$after" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || { echo CREATOR_POLLER_COUNT_INVALID; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$after")" = "$newid" || { echo CREATOR_IMAGE_MISMATCH; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$after")" = true || { echo CREATOR_POLLER_DOWN; false; }
trap - ERR
echo VIDEO_GALLERY_DESCRIPTION_STARS_DEPLOY=PASS
echo VIDEO_POLLER_COUNT=1
echo SOURCE_SHA=034fa012cf96e0288591fbe4bc16b90cee1acfa0
